segments.he: גְּמָ׳ תָּנוּ רַבָּנַן: יֵשׁ נִקְרִין וּמִתַּרְגְּמִין, וְיֵשׁ נִקְרִין וְלֹא מִתַּרְגְּמִין, וְיֵשׁ לֹא נִקְרִין וְלֹא מִתַּרְגְּמִין. אֵלּוּ נִקְרִין וּמִתַּרְגְּמִין. בָּלַ״‎ת עָקָ״‎ן נִשְׁפֶּ״‎ה סִימָן.
segments.en: «GEMARA:» «The Sages taught» in the Tosefta (3:31): «There are» portions of the Bible that are «read and translated; there are» portions that «are read but not translated; and there are» portions that «are neither read nor translated. The following are read and translated:» The Hebrew acronym «bet, lamed, tav; ayin, kuf, nun; nun, shin, peh, heh» comprise «a mnemonic» for the sections included in this category, as the Gemara will explain.
